Specs first (TDD RED with the manual TAP summary lines), with `fetch` stubbed to a valid `shareCreateResponseSchema` body and `APP_ORIGIN` provided as `http://app.test`.
1. `services/share.repo.ts`: `ShareRepo` (root) injects `NativeIndexedDBService`; `put(record: ShareRecord): Promise<ShareRecord>` (parse, `db.update('shares', parsed)`), `get(shareId: string): Promise<ShareRecord | null>` (parse on read). Store name constant `'shares'`.
2. `stores/share.store.ts`:
   - `ShareBudgetError extends Error` with `reason: 'pages' | 'images' | 'image-bytes' | 'payload-bytes'`. `PublishResult { url: string; record: ShareRecord; recordSaved: boolean }`.
   - Exported pure `buildSharePayload(character: Character, includedTypes: readonly string[], plugins): SharePayload`.
   - `ShareStore` (root) injects `ShareApiService`, `ShareRepo`, `CharacterStore`, `SUBDOC_PLUGINS`, `APP_ORIGIN`. `publishing = signal(false)`. `publishSnapshot(characterId, includedTypes): Promise<PublishResult>` shares an in-flight promise (the `LibraryStore.create` pattern).
   - Flow:
     - Require `characterStore.core()?.id === characterId` (else reject with an Error), `await characterStore.flush()`, read `character()`.
     - Build the payload and request `{ kind: 'snapshot', includedTypes: payload.pages.map(p => p.type), payload }`.
     - Local budget (UX guard, not a control): pages ≤ PAGES_MAX, images ≤ SHARE_IMAGES_MAX, summed bytes ≤ SHARE_IMAGE_BYTES_MAX, `TextEncoder` byte length of the JSON body ≤ SHARE_PAYLOAD_BYTES_MAX.
     - With `payload.images.length === 0`, skip the image exists/upload steps (RESEARCH Pitfall 1). No image refs can exist before Phase 4 ships its endpoints.
     - `createShare`, then `repo.put` of the record. On put failure, log `console.error('[ShareStore] could not store share record', err.name)`.
   - Discretion (flush before payload): implemented as above.
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm --filter @dossier/schema build && pnpm --filter web exec ng test --watch=false --include=src/app/services/share.repo.spec.ts --include=src/app/stores/share.store.spec.ts</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "No test files found" / "No tests found" in the output</fails_when>
  </verify>

  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>Publishing builds a correct snapshot payload, respects local budgets, dedupes double clicks, and always records the owner token or reports that it could not.</done>
